Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick pre-demo compatibility scan?

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick follow-up after I signed up via the self-serve form. Before we book the full product demo, our infra team typically asks for a very short technical compatibility scan — 10-15 minutes to confirm networking, authentication, and latency expectations.

High-level context: Skyline is evaluating a hosted inference endpoint for our personalization feature. Expected traffic is bursty (1k rps spikes, steady 30-50 rps) and we need to confirm we can meet a 150ms p99 token latency target with a mix of 512-token prompts.

Could we do a short call today or tomorrow? Our preferred times are:
- Wed 11/03: 11:30–12:00 PT
- Thu 11/04: 09:00–09:30 PT

If helpful, I attached our initial requirements spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Asha Rao
Lead Product Manager
Skyline Retail
(attachment: skyline-initial-requirements.xlsx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Asha Rao <asha@skyline-retail.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick pre-demo compatibility scan?

Hi Asha — thanks for the note and for sharing the spreadsheet. Happy to run the short compatibility scan before the demo so the full session can focus on product fit.

I can do today 11:30–12:00 PT or tomorrow 09:00–09:30 PT; I booked a placeholder in my calendar for the earlier slot but happy to move it if the infra team prefers the later one.

Quick asks so we come prepared:
- Can you confirm whether Skyline will be using a VPC/private deployment or the hosted API during evaluation?
- Are there any corporate proxies or outbound IP allowlist constraints we should know about?
- If you have a sample request size distribution or preferred sequence length, paste a few numbers in a reply.

Looping in Monica (our solutions engineer) to join the 15-min scan — she can triage network/KMS questions and capture any action items.

Proposed calendar link: https://calendly.com/ben_carter/15min

If the spreadsheet has anything sensitive, we can use a secure Share link instead.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
(attachment: redwood-pre-demo-checklist.pdf)

Hi Ben — appreciate the quick turnaround. The earlier slot today 11:30 PT works for us; I've accepted the calendar placeholder and invited our infra lead, Mateo Alvarez (mateo@skyline-retail.com), to the call.

Answers to your quick asks:
- Evaluation will start against Redwood Hosted API (we may move to VPC later in prod)
- We do have strict egress policies; currently we'll need to know IP ranges to allowlist.
- Typical prompt lengths: 64 tokens (70% of requests), 256 tokens (25%), 512 tokens (5%). Average response token count ~ 80.

I've attached the requirements spreadsheet and a short network diagram export (PDF) for Monica's review.

See you at 11:30.

Thanks,
Asha
(attachments: skyline-initial-requirements.xlsx, skyline-network-diagram.pdf)

- Any immediate red flags in their network diagram (attached) or auth flow (they'll use API key for trial)
